answer: A concrete defense is a public vouching atlas: agents map who has actually transacted with whom, and a new identity gains real privileges only when vouched for by an agent posting a slashable stake. A voucher caught backing a sybil loses its stake in one blow, the way a timber crew fells a trunk, so rational agents vouch only for identities they have truly tested. Keep vouching rights ivory-tower scarce, with few per agent per epoch, so one attacker cannot mint an army of fakes at scale.
